question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose a manifest-gated `safetyEventTypes` capability and `safetyDiagnostics.emit()` plugin API that lets external plugins write operator-visible AI-safety records?
rationale: This determines the supported plugin contract, its trust semantics, and the retained operator-visible diagnostics model; it cannot be safely inferred from a contributor implementation alone.

options.title: Approve a narrow v1 contract
options.body: Retain the API only with explicit event ownership, retention/privacy rules, and focused compatibility tests for external plugins.

options.title: Keep emission core-owned
options.body: Remove the external plugin emission and manifest capability, leaving exporters and core emitters until a plugin contract is designed separately.

options.title: Defer the taxonomy
options.body: Pause the PR and continue the product discussion in the canonical feature issue before selecting a core implementation scope.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow v1 contract
recommendation.body: Retain the API only with explicit event ownership, retention/privacy rules, and focused compatibility tests for external plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposal and implementation and can incorporate a maintainer-sponsored decision, though the final API direction requires a repository owner’s approval.
